criteria.text: The contract list names records, their owner files and their current prompt and test users.
Changing a used shared record marks every Story using it stale since its last actual check.
A different record in the same file leaves an unrelated Story in the same batch current.
No actual check baseline is shown as not checked, and a legacy baseline is shown as unavailable.
Lint and Try do not replace an actual check baseline.
Listing contracts makes no runtime call and changes no source or history.
Checking one test, all tests of the same Story or a larger batch leaves an unchanged Story current.
Listing many records from one JSON file reads and parses that file once and leaves independent uses unchanged.

cases.given: Markdown descriptive section, heading with spaces, JSON schema node, unused record; two prompt users and one seeded test
cases.required_observation: list canonical targets, owner files, exact users and Stories; descriptive section omitted; unused record has no users

cases.given: actual Check for Stories A and B using record agent; edit agent; include a nested use
cases.required_observation: agent changed; A and B stale; check baseline remains its submitted value

cases.given: A uses agent, B uses ticket in one Markdown file; both checked in one batch; edit agent only
cases.required_observation: A stale; B current; unrelated raw record bytes neither uploaded nor part of B fingerprint

cases.given: one Story never checked; one historical receipt has no reference snapshots
cases.required_observation: not checked and baseline unavailable respectively; no invented changed record

cases.given: actual Check snapshot old; edit record; complete lint and Try; then an evaluated Check
cases.required_observation: lint/Try leave old baseline and stale status; later actual Check advances only its Story

cases.given: offline local catalog/history with auth/fetch/slot/write spies
cases.required_observation: all external and write counts 0; finite local output

cases.given: Story A has tests one.json and two.json using distinct prompts and dependency files; Story B has other.json; save actual A baseline from one.json, then list against all tests; repeat baseline from both A tests and A+B batch
cases.required_observation: A footprint has both A tests and their own closures and stays identical/current across selections; B dependencies absent from A; selected upload includes only selected tests; changing A second-test dependency makes A stale

cases.given: one synthetic JSON contract file containing 256 independent object-schema records plus used leaf pointers and repeated nested targets; repeat catalog with 512 records; use parser/read instrumentation on the existing public codec if present, no extra parser
cases.required_observation: each file read/parsed once per catalog operation; independent records and annotations do not mutate cached values; no complete-file parse per record; output catalog identities and values exact; no timing gate

cases.given: Story A has selected good.json and unselected wip.json; wip names a nonexistent entry prompt. Capture/check/try good.json first without any contracts, then with a valid selected contract reference; fake auth/transport and temporary Git/source state.
cases.required_observation: selected good work continues through its ordinary gates with exactly its selected upload; wip footprint unavailable with missing-prompt cause; Story A completeness/current freshness unavailable, no synthetic successful sibling or partial complete baseline; no wip upload

cases.given: Story A has selected good.json and unselected wip.json whose initial_world seed file is missing; good selected source is valid.
cases.required_observation: good capture/check/try can proceed; unavailable sibling footprint identifies the missing seed; no missing seed contents invented and no false current/complete Story footprint

cases.given: Story A good test plus unselected sibling with missing local Markdown dependency, cyclic contract target or unsafe secret/symlink dependency in separate variants; Story B valid selected test in same batch.
cases.required_observation: good selected A/B source remains eligible; unsafe sibling target is never read/uploaded; A footprint unavailable with cause, B complete footprint unchanged; selected common inputs still obey all refusal/privacy rules

cases.given: select the missing-entry or missing-seed sibling itself; separately require its missing/unsafe dependency from the good selected test as well.
cases.required_observation: selected work refuses before upload/authentication with existing missing/unsafe diagnostics; sibling-only tolerance does not weaken selected-source checks

cases.given: save a complete actual Check baseline for Story A with two valid tests and distinct closures; break unselected second-test prompt/seed, capture first test and list; restore exact original bytes; compare captures selecting first, both and A+B; finally change valid second-test dependency.
cases.required_observation: broken period reports footprint unavailable without fabricating current or replacing a complete baseline with a partial closure; restored complete A footprint equals its original across selections and is current; later valid sibling dependency change makes A stale; B files never enter A footprint
